intro: Gabon's culture is famous for its masks and spiritual traditions.

chapters.title: Masks
text: Fang reliquary figures and Punu white-faced masks influenced European artists like Picasso.

chapters.title: Food
text: Nyembwe (chicken in palm nut sauce) is the national dish.
